title: Commander William Beresford Moffitt Marks DSC RAN (left), Lieutenant Dacre Henry Smyth RAN ... · 권리:PD(저작권 만료)
summary: Commander William Beresford Moffitt Marks DSC RAN (left), Lieutenant Dacre Henry Smyth RAN (right) and Lieutenant Patrick Richard Burnett RAN (in background) standing on the wings of the bridge of HMAS Bataan as the ship slips from alongside a depot repair ship in the port of Kure, Japan, to take part in the US-led landing at Inchon.
